data.title: Find the Missing Part with 5!
data.description: Practice finding the missing part of a number bond within five to build addition and subtraction fluency.

challenges.instruction: We have 3 apples in all. If 1 apple is in the first basket, how many are in the second basket to make 3?
Our whole group has 4 stars. If 2 stars are shining bright, how many more stars do we need to make 4?
There are 5 blocks in total. If 1 block is hiding, how many blocks can you see to make 5?
We counted 4 flowers altogether. If 3 flowers are red, how many yellow flowers make 4?
Let us make 5! If we have 2 bouncy balls, how many more bouncy balls do we need to make 5?
